statements.headline: An AI researcher working on <mark>multimodal generative models</mark> 🧑‍🔬
statements.body: I study how to generate music and images from text in a controllable way. MIDILM was accepted to the AAAI 2026 Main Track as co-first author, and PixTention was published in Image and Vision Computing (IF 4.7) as first author.

statements.headline: Moving big models with small updates through <mark>adaptation</mark> 💪
statements.body: I study LLMs and multimodal models from a PEFT point of view (LoRA, P-Tuning v2, Adapter). I serve as a reviewer for EAAI and TCSVT, and my team was selected as a top-100 team (of 630) in the AI Champion Program and exhibited at 2025 AI Festa (COEX).

skills: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face (Transformers / Diffusers / PEFT)
PEFT design and implementation (LoRA, P-Tuning v2, Adapter)
LLM · Diffusion · Vision-Language Model · Symbolic Music (MIDI) Generation

hello.title: Hi! I'm Dooho 👋
hello.body: I'm an MS student at Dongguk University, advised by Prof. Yunsick Sung. I study how to generate music from text in a controllable way, and I am now focusing on music generation research such as text-to-MIDI. My co-first-author work MIDILM was accepted to the AAAI 2026 Main Track, and my first-author work PixTention was published in Image and Vision Computing (IF 4.7). This line of work has produced 6 papers and 4 IPs. I also serve as a reviewer for EAAI and TCSVT.
